name: Docker Desktop
note: Docker Desktop has no dedicated keyboard-shortcut reference page. These are the only shortcuts Docker documents, drawn from its official release notes across versions: Zoom in/out/Actual Size added in 4.12.0 ("Added the ability to zoom in, out or set Docker Desktop to Actual Size. This is done by using keyboard shortcuts ⌘ + / CTRL +, ⌘ - / CTRL -, ⌘ 0 / CTRL 0 on Mac and Windows respectively, or through the View menu on Mac."), with the Windows zoom-in chord confirmed literally as ctrl+= in a 4.19.0 bug fix; Restart via ctrl-r on the Dashboard noted in 4.4.2; Quit via Cmd+Q (Mac) / Ctrl+Q (Windows, also Linux) confirmed in the 4.73.0 bug fix. An older 4.8.0 note about an Windows "Ctrl+W" shortcut was omitted as superseded/ambiguous next to the more recent, explicit Ctrl+Q quit fix.
